notes.title: Global Update 6.9
notes.content:
New system "Battle Slots" and "Collection":
A new system "Battle Slots" has been introduced — a squad that will go into battle. The number of battle slots is limited. In battle, you will only face opponents of equal strength based on the vehicles installed in the battle slots.

All vehicles has been moved to the "Collection". The number of collection slots has been increased to 25.
New map:
A new map "Dawn Pass" has been introduced — far from civilization, among picturesque mountains, lies a quiet village...
Battle Pass:
Battle Pass Operation "New Banner".

Rewards: in-game currency, camouflage, VIP, gold shells.

Premium rewards: light tank level 10 BRT-82A Phoenix and medium tank level 10 PLL09 Vostok.
New vehicles:
BRT-82A Phoenix — the embodiment of lightning strikes and tactical flexibility, capable of turning the tide of battle.

PLL09 Vostok — proof that true power knows no bounds, and a true legend is born in the fire.

notes.title: Global update 6.8
notes.content:
Equipment and Consumables:

Radio Monitoring Station — detects enemy drone launches and alerts players when drones get dangerously close.

Electronic Jamming Module — disables enemy drone video feed within a certain radius (does not destroy the drone).

Armor Penetration System and Updated Armor Zones:

New penetration system introduced with individually calculated armor zones.

Full damage dealt on successful penetration; partial damage if penetration fails.

Battle Pass:

New "Nuclear Summer" Battle Pass available for 40 days.

80 unique missions.

Rewards include in-game currency, camouflages, VIP status, and gold shells.

Premium rewards: two Tier 11 light tanks — AT-18 Waste Lord and SCV-25 Scorcher.

New Vehicles:

AT-18 Waste Lord — strong armor, high mobility, ramming damage.

SCV-25 Scorcher — high speed, fast acceleration, rapid fire rate.

notes.title: New Year Update
notes.content:
New Battle Pass: "Holiday War game"

 80 missions with progressive difficulty.
 Three premium tanks:
 Merrykava X level: A heavy tank with unique progressive appearances.

New Holiday Hangar: Feel the cozy atmosphere of the season! The hangar is decorated in a festive style to bring a sense of wonder to every battle.

Holiday Offers
Special festive bundles with tanks, currency, and rare items are now available in the store. Don’t miss the chance to grab unique deals!

notes.title: New mechanics, event and more
notes.content:
Greetings!
In this major update, we have the following new features for you:


 Vehicles armor zones of each combat unit have been completely redesigned. Remember that now you can knock down the tracks of the enemy or disable the cannon module to weaken the enemy! Added special visual effects when destroying armor zones.
 A unique event is starting - OPERATION "HEATWAVE"
Enter the game, complete tasks in the chain and receive rewards
 During the OPERATION "HEATWAVE" event, you have a unique opportunity to get a medium premium tank of level 10 AT-80 UM1 Desert Hunter. This powerful war beast will become a true decoration of your arsenal!
 The visuals of the "Alpine Frontier" map has been updated: vegetation, effects and much more have been improved
 When inspecting vehicle, a preview of armor zones became available - study the weakest points of the enemy's vehicles!
 The interface of the main menu has been significantly changed
 Old tank models have been updated to more detailed and elaborated ones - Challenger2, Type90ll, Type63All, Stryker, Btr82
 Bugfixes


Thank you for your attention, good luck in the fight!

notes.title: New Year's Eve event!
notes.content:
This update is mainly related to the New Year's event and the new battle pass! 
[olist]
 Added battle pass!

Also in this update:

 Maps have been optimized, and new objects have been added to the maps
 In general, optimization for weak devices (mainly affects mobile devices)

notes.title: Halloween and big economy changes
notes.content:
It's almost Halloween – and we have something special for this occasion!

Thematic changes: 
[olist]
 Added 2 new hell-themed wheeled tanks
 Together with these tanks, a new mechanic appeared - unlockable skins. Play on your favorite vehicle, upgrade its rank, and along with this new looks of vehicle will open up, changing it beyond recognition!
 A Halloween quest chain has been added - complete tasks throughout the event and receive pleasant rewards
 Added Halloween hangars - immerse yourself in the holiday atmosphere
[/olist]

Also for this update we have prepared huge changes to the economy of the game:
[olist]
 Silver shells became free on all vehicles
 The price of consumables became the same on vehicles of all levels
 Reduced the cost of all premium vehicles
 Vehicle research with a new balance has been returned
 The modules upgrade time with a new balance has been returned
 Changed the restriction on opening clans (5th level) and commanders (2nd level)
 There was a rebalance and flattening of the economy - absolutely ALL prices in silver were changed (on average reduced by ~3 times). However, do not be surprised, and the earnings of silver from all sources have been changed (on average reduced by the same value).
 Prices and experience earnings are also very much changed
[/olist]

Other changes:
[olist]
 Tanks tree interface changed 
 Bugfixes
[/olist]

notes.title: War of Tanks global update #2
notes.content:
Greetings, tankmans :)

An update has been released in the War of Tanks game!

Major changes:


 Completely redesigned map - Alpine Frontier
 4 new consumables: FPS kamikaze drones with different projectiles and characteristics
 2 new consumables and equipment affecting the battering damage
 Updated models of 13 tanks
 Added ranks for each vehicle - show everyone how experienced you are on this vehicle
 New tank module for battering damage
 Battering damage is now included in the statistics after the battle and is awarded
 New international commander
 Complete chat rewamp
 Gameplay improvements and bug fixes


We are waiting for feedback from all of you about the new update! If you encounter any error in the game, please contact our technical support via the game hangar or by mail: support@xtornadogames.com
